reasoning.description: Identifies the struct `{{GOD_STRUCT}}` in `{{FILE_PATH}}` with LCOM4 = {{LCOM4_VALUE}} (>2) but low cognitive complexity in its individual methods.
reasoning.rationale: The god object must be named.

reasoning.description: Lists the distinct responsibilities of the struct: {{RESPONSIBILITIES}} (e.g., payment, inventory, logging).
Maps each field and method to its responsibility island (e.g., `PaymentProcessor` methods use `payment_field1`, `payment_field2`).
Proposes a split into separate structs: `{{SPLIT1}}`, `{{SPLIT2}}`, `{{SPLIT3}}` (one per responsibility).
Shows a dependency injection diagram (text or ASCII) of how the new structs interact.
Explains that the original internal function bodies can stay identical; only the ownership changes.
Estimates the reduction in LCOM4 after splitting (target LCOM4 = 1 for each new struct).
Recommends updating the module exports to reflect the new structure.
Asserts that this refactoring improves maintainability without changing external behaviour.
(Bonus) Suggests using a builder pattern for the new structs if they have many parameters.
(Bonus) Compares with another struct in the codebase that already follows SRP correctly.
(Bonus) Proposes introducing a trait to define common behaviour if the split structs share logic.

penalty.description: Suggests minor internal cleanup (renaming, adding comments) instead of the macro structural split.
Proposes keeping the god struct and adding more methods to it.
Claims that low LCOM4 is not a problem because all methods are short.
Suggests splitting the struct but not updating the module exports, breaking compilation.
Recommends removing some methods instead of splitting.
Ignores the low cognitive complexity clue and claims the code is already perfect.

completeness.description: Cites the exact file path `{{FILE_PATH}}` and struct name `{{GOD_STRUCT}}`.
Lists all fields belonging to each responsibility group (e.g., `{{FIELD_GROUP1}}`).
Mentions the file’s total lines of code ({{LOC}}) and number of functions ({{FUNC_COUNT}}).
(Bonus) Includes a before/after module tree diagram showing the split.

style.description: Uses a markdown table or bullet list to map responsibilities to fields/methods.
Presents the dependency injection diagram as ASCII art or a simple text diagram.
